# Phase-1 output goldens (placeholder)

Reserved for **output** structural goldens that have no natural fixture to sit
beside (Implementation Plan §3.1, S-13 → Phase 1):

- `docx/` — Part A DOCX structural assertions (13 sections present, empty
  fields render "Not identified from code", inputs/outputs/DQ as tables).
- `xlsx/` — Part B XLSX structural assertions (exactly 9 sheets, exact column
  headers/order, provenance/confidence color coding).

These land with the exporters in **Phase 1** (P1-T6 / P1-T7). Everything else in
the corpus uses **co-located** `expected.json` next to its source fixture (see
`../README.md`).
